mood: white-neutral overhead cafe table with broad upper-left window light and off-frame room shadows

reference_cluster.selection_rule: right-dominant circular white table, narrow left gray tiled floor wedge, complete single product and spatial off-frame shadows

key_light.source: one large upper-left window diffused by room air and partial unseen architecture
key_light.relative_size: large; product shadow is soft while broader environmental shadows retain readable but feathered boundaries

ambient_fill: neutral room bounce below the key; retain floor grout, table texture and contact depth

fill_contract.source: weak neutral room bounce from the surrounding white interior
fill_contract.color_bias: neutral to faintly cool relative to the warm-neutral key

screen_light_map.gobo_geometry: partial off-frame architecture or furniture represented only as soft abstract shadow masses

specular_contract.highlight_shape: broad upper-left arcs on glass or ceramic with protected white detail
specular_contract.rim_continuity: continuous readable upper rim with no melted or broken vessel edge
specular_contract.transparent_caustic: subtle and physically connected only when the preserved source container is transparent

shadow_contract.edge: soft to moderately soft, physically attached and naturally irregular
shadow_contract.attachment: small denser contact occlusion beneath the product plus one short lower-right product shadow
shadow_contract.transparent_material: transparent source containers retain a connected transmitted lift and background-dependent refraction

contact_shadow.behavior: compact attachment directly beneath the vessel

cast_shadow.behavior: one short soft product shadow plus broad partial off-frame room shadows crossing table and floor

transmitted_light.behavior: subtle beverage-colored lift only inside a physically connected transparent shadow

capture_contract.hdr: restrained social-photo HDR with protected white detail and no halo
capture_contract.white_balance: warm-neutral white table with neutral-to-faintly-cool gray floor and shadows
capture_contract.texture: plain matte table, lightly mottled tile, readable product detail and faint luminance grain

reference_anchor.role: user-approved spatial anchor; provider submission forbidden

camera_coupling.support_plane: light preserves the raised circular table edge against the lower gray floor
camera_coupling.shadow_projection: product and environmental shadows project consistently from upper left toward lower right across both planes
camera_coupling.depth_response: falloff, edge height and receding floor grout remain readable under an 84-89 degree camera pitch

color_separation.shadow_neutral: quiet neutral to faintly cool gray
color_separation.material_locality: source-authoritative beverage color, ice and garnish remain inside the reconstructed drink; sidewall branding is not forced at the overhead camera, and opaque adopted-cup exteriors remain clean
